description: Quality settings for research.verify_character. Rules ported from research/verify_crystal_mage.py: the crystal in all eight directions, the book where the left side faces the camera, an unbroken staff from the floor.

walk.description: Thresholds for research.verify_walk. The staff foot must stay on or above the floor. The book is hidden by the body in N and the hilt-side views, as in idle, so it has no walk pixel rule; staff and crystal use about half of the smallest measured counts (7 px and 4 px). walk.head.face is a known WARNING: in SW and SE the head alone draws 3 eye pixels instead of 4 on the two dip frames (the walk before walk.head had the same, and 2 instead of 4 in S).
